Ramayana film trailer sparks debate over casting and portrayal

The trailer for the upcoming film 'Ramayana', starring Ranbir Kapoor as Ram and Yash as Ravan, has been released, generating significant public discussion. Viewers have raised questions about specific casting choices, including the portrayal of characters like Kaikeyi and the absence of Sunny Deol. Deepika Chikhalia, who played Sita in the original 'Ramayan' series, has publicly supported the casting of Ranbir Kapoor and Sai Pallavi, stating that the actor from 'Animal' can play Ram and that Sai Pallavi will be excellent as Sita. Some commentary speculates on the film's potential to win an Oscar.
